digest.component_or_area: llm core: runner, capabilities, providers, structured
propositions: The comment at runner.py:94-97 claiming extra_tools 'is always None in practice' is stale; the field is load-bearing and actively set by completion_recovery.py:469,665 and threaded through runs.py

Three sites assert Anthropic 400 errors when extended thinking meets native output constraints, contradicting structured.py:228-238 which calls that rationale stale; the actual gate is native_structured_output AND (NOT thinking OR native_output_with_thinking)

capabilities.py:166-198 is a structurally complete ADR documenting web-search security posture (blocking gate, three numbered bounds, accepted limitation) that exists nowhere else in the codebase and must be relocated to a new ADR
providers.py:3-16 verbatim duplicates ADR 0059 §1 including file:line citations and can be collapsed to a citation
capabilities.py:295-316 (measured AWS-cost capability matrix) and capabilities.py:269-281 (rejected-alternative warning) are load-bearing measured facts that must remain verbatim
